meta.tagline: The German Real-Time Mobility Context Platform for AI
meta.pitch: ViaFrei gives AI assistants real-time awareness of Germany. Trains and buses, traffic and roadworks, fuel, charging, parking and weather. One MCP. No API key. No sign-up.
meta.description: Jams, closures, roadworks, rail, parking, charging and fuel across Germany – live from open data, answered by your AI assistant, every figure with its source.

beta.label: Beta
beta.short: ViaFrei is in beta: answers and coverage can change, and the AI can make mistakes. Please check important details with the source named.

hero.lead: Like a well-informed friend: is my train running? Is the motorway clear? Is a charger free? ViaFrei gives your assistant today's figures, each with its source.
hero.primary: Connect your AI in a minute
hero.phase: Early phase: answers are information, not legal advice.
hero.connected: Your AI assistant uses this live data only when ViaFrei is connected to it – without the connection it answers from its training data.

notAnswered.heading: What we do not answer

notAnswered.legal: No legal advice — the rules answers name their source and review date and are information.
notAnswered.fuelFeed: No price data to build on — fuel prices are consumer information, not an API.

privacy.heading: Privacy in three sentences
privacy.s1: Before you agree, this page loads no third-party font, script or image.
privacy.s2: We count visits without cookies, only as daily totals on our own server; Google Analytics runs only if you agree.
privacy.s2Clarity: We count visits without cookies, only as daily totals on our own server; Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity run only if you agree.
privacy.s3: Your assistant talks to our server — we keep no accounts and no profiles.

day.heading: Your day with ViaFrei
day.lead: Nine moments when one short question saves time — with today's figure that shows the answer holds.
day.howToText: Tap and hold a question (or select it), copy, paste it into the chat. Your assistant picks the right tool itself.

commute.title: The morning commute
commute.scene: 7:10, coffee in hand: is public transport running normally — and is my train on time?
commute.q1: Are buses and trains in Hamburg running on time right now?
commute.a1: {share} % of the trips observed in the last hour were more than 5 minutes late — more than the hour before ({before} %).
commute.limit: We show punctuality per region, not per line.
commute.q2: When is the next train from Leipzig Central Station, and is it late?
commute.q3: Are any trains on the Cologne Central Station departure board cancelled in the next hour?
commute.a2: Next is {l1} to {d1} (due {t1}, platform {p1}), running +{delay} min, leaving around {exp}; then {l2} to {d2} at {t2}, on time.
commute.a3: None is cancelled: {n} departures up to {last}; the biggest delay is {l1} to {d1}, +{delay} min.

bus.title: By bus and tram
bus.scene: Out in town: where is the nearest station, and is transport running?
bus.q1: Which railway station is nearest to Cologne Cathedral?
bus.q2: When is the next S-Bahn from Frankfurt Hauptwache?
bus.limit: We will show the timetable of every bus and tram stop once it is loaded — until then, stations and the situation in your region.
bus.a2: Next is the {l1} to {d1} at {t1} from platform {p1}, on time; the {l2} to {d2} due at {t2} is +{delay2} min, leaving around {exp2}.
bus.q3: Are trains leaving Dresden main station late right now?
bus.a3: Yes, two: the {l1} to {d1}, +{dl1} min, from platform {p1}, and the {l2} to {d2}, +{dl2} min; the other {n} upcoming departures are on time.

station.title: At the station
station.scene: With a pram, a wheelchair or luggage: is the lift to the platform working?
station.q1: Is the lift at Cologne Central Station working?
station.a1: At {station}, {working} of {total} reported lifts are in service; one is out of service, and for one the railway reports no status.
station.limit: Lifts and escalators at Deutsche Bahn stations; other operators not yet.
station.q2: Are all lifts at Erlangen station in service?
station.a2: Yes: the one lift reported at {station}, to platform {platforms}, is in service.
station.q3: Which platform does the next ICE from Nuremberg Central Station leave from?
station.a3: The {train} to {dest} at {t} from platform {p}, on time.

driving.title: On the road
driving.scene: Before you set off: jams, closures, roadworks — and where fuel is cheap right now.
driving.q1: Is the A8 towards Munich clear right now?
driving.a1: Not entirely: between {a} and {b} towards Munich the police report an accident; the hard shoulder is blocked.
driving.a1more: Across the whole A8, {closures} closures and {works} roadworks entries are listed as well.
driving.limit: No route planning: we say what is happening on the motorway, not which way you should drive.
driving.q2: Which roadworks are on the A7 right now?
driving.a2: {count} roadworks sites up to {to}; for example between {a} and {b}: a new bridge, one of three lanes closed, {speed} km/h, until {until}.
driving.q3: I'm driving on the A2 at the weekend — which roadworks should I expect?
driving.a3: {count} roadworks sites from {from} to {to}; for example at the {a} junction: the pavement is being renewed and the ramp is fully closed, until {until}.

jam.title: Stuck in traffic
jam.scene: Jams on the motorway and around the cities: where traffic stands, how much time it costs — and whether there is a closure tonight.
jam.q1: How much time is the jam on the A3 between Frankfurt and Würzburg costing right now?
jam.a1: Between {a} and {b} towards Frankfurt about +{delay} min, after an accident; {jams} jams are reported along the whole A3.
jam.a1more: Listed on the A3: {closures} closures and {works} roadworks entries.
jam.limit: In cities we see the urban motorways, and in Berlin, Cologne and Hanover also the city's own traffic messages — not yet the situation on every street. Hamburg's messages and Cologne's traffic state have been requested from the providers.
jam.q2: Is traffic backed up on the Cologne motorway ring right now — A1, A3 or A4?
jam.q3: Is the A7 closed in Hamburg today?
jam.a3: A closure is reported between the {a} and {b} junctions (widening to eight lanes, new {tunnel}); along the whole A7 there are {n} closures.
jam.a2: Yes, on the A4: between {a} and {b} towards Cologne traffic is slow, about +{delay} min; {n} jams are reported on the motorways asked about.

parking.title: Parking
parking.scene: Leave the car at the station — or, as a lorry driver, plan your break.
parking.q1: Where is a car park near Cologne Central Station?
parking.a1: {p1}: last reported {f1} of {t1} spaces free; {p2}: {f2} of {t2} — both within 300 m.
parking.limit: Free spaces only where the operator publishes them — otherwise the number of spaces, not how full they are.
parking.q2: Where is there lorry parking on the A9?
parking.a2: For example {p1} with {n1} lorry spaces, {p2} with {n2} and {p3} with {n3}; nobody publishes free spaces there.
parking.q3: Where is park-and-ride near Essen main station?
parking.a3: {p1}, {k1}.{k1d} km away, and {p2}, {k2}.{k2d} km; ViaFrei does not take the occupancy from this source.

charging.title: Charging
charging.scene: Driving electric: where is the nearest charger, and is a point free?
charging.q1: Where can I charge fast near Leipzig?
charging.q2: Which fast chargers are there near Ingolstadt?
charging.a1: With at least 150 kW, for example: {site}, {address} — up to {kw} kW.
charging.a1more: The operator publishes no live status, so ViaFrei says “unknown”, not “free”.
charging.limit: Availability for the networks that publish it; for all others we show the location, not the status.
charging.a2: Nearest is {op1}, {a1}, up to {kw1} kW: {free1} of {total1} charge points free; also {s2}, {a2}, up to {kw2} kW, with no current status.
charging.q3: Is anything free at the Hilden Supercharger right now?
charging.a3: {brand} last reported a status on {t} — too old to say “free”; at {address}, up to {kw} kW.

places.title: Finding places
places.scene: A name is enough: the concert hall, the pharmacy, the company — with its address and a coordinate for the next question.
places.q1: My satnav shows 50.1109, 8.6821 — what address is that, and where is the nearest motorway junction?
places.a1: {address}, {m} m away. Nearest motorway junction: {junction}, {km}.{kmd} km away.
places.limit: Places and addresses come from OpenStreetMap; every answer states the data date. What is not mapped there we cannot find — opening hours and ratings are not part of it.
places.q2: Which pharmacies are there in Fulda — with their addresses?
places.q3: What is the address of the Elbphilharmonie in Hamburg?

watch.title: Tell me when
watch.scene: No need to keep checking: ViaFrei watches for you and keeps every change in the conversation — your assistant shows it as soon as you ask, or by itself if it supports notifications.
watch.q1: Tell me as soon as a closure on the A7 is lifted.
watch.limit: This conversation only, while it is open — no e-mail, no SMS. Up to 10 watches per conversation, each for up to 24 hours; a road is watched as a whole, not one section.
watch.a1: Watch set: the {road}, until {until}. ViaFrei reports in this chat as soon as a closure there is lifted; {used} of 10 watches in use.
watch.q2: Let me know when a quarter or more of the bus and train trips in Cologne are running late.
watch.a2: Watch set: region {ags} ({city}), reporting from {pct} % of trips late, until {until} — in this chat only.
watch.q3: Warn me when a severe weather warning from the German Weather Service comes into force for Cologne.
watch.a3: Watch set: DWD warning area {cell} ({city}), until {until} — ViaFrei reports here as soon as the situation changes.

fuelAsks.heading: A question that can save money at the pump

goerlitz.q: Where is diesel cheapest in Görlitz right now?
goerlitz.why: Prices change several times a day and differ even between a few stations in one town: ViaFrei names the cheapest with its price and the time the station reported it.

muenchen.q: Where is E10 petrol cheapest in Munich right now?
muenchen.why: A price can be from the morning: for Munich that afternoon ViaFrei held only prices from the morning, gave each with its time and asked for new ones.
muenchen.a: No new price yet — the lowest last known: €{euro}.{cent} per litre at {station}, {address}, reported on {reported}; ViaFrei is asking for a new one.

leipzig.q: Where is E5 petrol cheapest in Leipzig right now?
leipzig.why: Prices change several times a day and differ even between a few stations in one town: ViaFrei names the cheapest with its price and the time the station reported it.

nuernberg.q: Where is diesel cheapest in Nuremberg right now?
nuernberg.why: The nearest station is not always the cheapest: ViaFrei gives the distance with each price.
nuernberg.a: No new price yet — the lowest last known: €{euro}.{cent} per litre at {station}, {address}, reported on {reported}; ViaFrei is asking for a new one.

connectPage.title: Connect ViaFrei to your assistant
connectPage.lead: One address, no account, no key. Add ViaFrei once as a connector – then just ask.
connectPage.askLead: Five questions, the way your assistant answers them today:

asks.train: Next departures from Cologne main station, please.
asks.parking: Where can I leave the car near Freiburg station? Answer in English.
asks.charging: Is there a 300 kW charger near Hannover for a quick stop?
asks.road: Is the A9 towards Nuremberg moving at the moment?
asks.weather: Are there any storm warnings for Hamburg right now?

live.heading: Answers, as they came
live.lead: Shortened, with the time of the data and its sources. The figures are a snapshot of that moment, not a live display.
live.fuelExample: Example answer of {asOf} — prices are different today

stadtbahn.title: Lifts and escalators on the Stadtbahn
stadtbahn.q: What is out of service at the {stop} Stadtbahn stop in Cologne right now?
stadtbahn.a: {out} of {total} reported facilities: escalators {e1} and {e2}, reported since {since}, {e3} since {since3} and {e4} since {since4}; both lifts in service. {publisher} provides the data without any warranty.
stadtbahn.note: For Cologne's Stadtbahn stops, from the published fault list – with the time each fault was reported.

bikes.title: Shared bikes at the station, live
bikes.q: Where can I find a free hire bike near {station}?
bikes.a: {dock} dock by {operator}: {free} bikes free, and {docks} docks within {radius} km, each with its own count.
bikes.note: Free bikes come live from the bike-share systems' open data; ViaFrei says only what a dock is reporting right now.

lift.title: Lifts at the station
lift.q: Which lifts at {station} station are out of service right now?
lift.a: One is reported out of service, a lift to platforms {platforms}: {working} of {total} lifts in service. The other lift to platforms {platforms} is not monitored – its status is unknown.
lift.note: For Deutsche Bahn stations, read every 20 minutes. Whatever the latest report does not mention is “unknown” – never “in service”.

alert.title: Bus and rail service alerts
alert.q: Are there any bus and rail service alerts in Lower Saxony right now?
alert.a: {count} alerts are in force, among them: lines {lines} run to a roadworks timetable because the {road} is closed between {a} and {b} – valid from {from} to {to}.
alert.note: Alerts from the transport associations via DELFI, only while they are in force. An alert that names no stop is placed in a Land by its network, and ViaFrei says that it may concern a neighbouring Land too.

enbw.title: Fast charger with live occupancy
enbw.q: Is a charging point free at the {brand} station at {address} right now?
enbw.a: Up to {kw} kW, €{euro}.{cent}/kWh — but there is no status for any of the {n} charge points, so ViaFrei does not say “free”.
enbw.note: The operator publishes its sites and occupancy itself; the “as of” time is its latest report.

ecomove.title: Live occupancy through an aggregator
ecomove.q: Is a charging point free at the fast charger at {address} right now?
ecomove.a: {site}: up to {kw} kW, €{euro}.{cent}/kWh; the last status dates from {t} — too old to say “free”.
ecomove.note: Here the occupancy comes from a service that gathers many operators' reports. A point without a report never counts as free.

ocpdb.title: Live free or busy, right in Cologne
ocpdb.q: Is a charging point free at the charger at {address} right now?
ocpdb.a: Yes, one: Type 2 up to {kw2} kW is free, the CCS point up to {kw} kW is out of order — €{euro}.{cent}/kWh before VAT.
ocpdb.note: Occupancy comes live through Baden-Württemberg's data portal, which also lists chargers far beyond that state.

lsr.title: Even where nobody reports live
lsr.a: {m} m away: Type 2, up to {kw} kW, per the Federal Network Agency's charging register (as of {register}), no live status and no warranty of accuracy or completeness.
lsr.note: Where no operator publishes live data, ViaFrei names the chargers from the official register, without occupancy, because unknown is never “free”.

hamburg.title: A car park in central Hamburg
hamburg.q: Where can I park near {stop} in Hamburg?
hamburg.a: {park}: {free} of {total} spaces free. The City of Hamburg itself says this real-time data is unverified.
hamburg.note: Hamburg's car-park occupancy comes live from the city; ViaFrei always passes on its note that the data is unverified.

hhworks.title: City roadworks in Hamburg
hhworks.q: What roadworks are planned on {street} in Hamburg?
hhworks.a: {street}, {b}: road rebuild from {from} to {to}; a full closure is expected in spring 2027.
hhworks.note: Hamburg's city roadworks come from the city's Bauweiser: released sites only, by calendar day, and "planned" means work starts after today. Police messages stay separate entries.

muenster.title: Münster's parking guidance, live
muenster.q: How many spaces are free at {name} in Münster?
muenster.a: {free} of {total} spaces free, plus {more} more car parks nearby, each with its own count.
muenster.note: Occupancy comes live from the City of Münster's parking guidance system. A car park that reports nothing is never called “full” by ViaFrei.

motorway.title: A closed slip road on the motorway
motorway.q: Is anything closed on the A6 near {place} right now?
motorway.a: Yes: the {place} slip road onto the A6 is closed while a structure is rebuilt – this construction phase runs from {from} to {to}. For the whole A6 the answer lists {count} closures.
motorway.note: Closures and roadworks on the motorways come from Autobahn GmbH, with the period of each construction phase. Asked about a motorway, ViaFrei lists the closures first.

citywork.title: Roadworks in the city
citywork.q: Is anything closed on {street} in Berlin?
citywork.a: Yes: utility works in both directions between {a} and {b}, closed to motor traffic according to the Senate department, from {from} to {to}.
citywork.note: Berlin's messages name the street and the section, not a road number, so ViaFrei finds them by place – within 25 km, nearest first.

landroad.title: Roadworks on a state road
landroad.q: Are there roadworks on the L1025 in Thuringia this week?
landroad.a: {count} roadworks sites, among them: {site}, a narrowing controlled by traffic lights, from {from} to {to}.
landroad.note: We cover state roads in Baden-Württemberg, Lower Saxony, Thuringia and Saxony, from the road authorities' data: section and period, no coordinates and no live delay.

saxony.title: Roadworks on a federal road in Saxony
saxony.q: Are there roadworks on the B6 in Saxony this week?
saxony.a: {count} roadworks sites this week, among them: near {place} in Dresden the road is being upgraded, from {from} to {to}.
saxony.note: Saxony's road authority republishes its long-term roadworks every three hours. ViaFrei answers them for federal and state roads, by section and period – no coordinates and no live delay.

bwroad.title: Roadworks on a federal road in Baden-Württemberg
bwroad.q: Are roadworks planned on the B27 in Baden-Württemberg next week?
bwroad.a: {count} of {all} sites are in Baden-Württemberg, e.g. {a} – {b}: a new road surface from {from} to {to}.
bwroad.note: Baden-Württemberg's transport ministry publishes its roadworks (BEMaS) through MobiData BW. ViaFrei answers them for federal and state roads, by section and period – planned work as planned, no live delay.

kiel.title: Roadworks in Kiel
kiel.q: Can you drive along {street} in Kiel right now?
kiel.a: No: {street} is closed between house number {no} and {b} for sewer works, from {from} to {to} (Example, summarised; the tool shows it in full).
kiel.note: The city of Kiel publishes its roadworks with place, reason and period. This card summarises one message; the tool shows them unabridged and finds a message by place – within 25 km, nearest first.

truckstop.title: Secure lorry parking on the A7
truckstop.q: Is there a free lorry space at {name} on the A7 tonight?
truckstop.a: {free} of {total} spaces free, as the operator reports them.
truckstop.note: The operator of these secure lorry parks publishes their free spaces; ViaFrei shows them beside the rest areas, which publish no occupancy, and never adds the two together.

parkride.title: Park and ride before the train
parkride.q: Where in Dortmund can I leave the car and change to the train?
parkride.a: {p1} with {t1} spaces and {p2} with {t2} spaces — no occupancy for these sites.
parkride.note: Park-and-ride sites in North Rhine-Westphalia come from the state's bundled data and are listed in a block of their own, never matched against other sources. Their occupancy is not taken over.

platform.title: A delay, live
platform.q: Is the {train} to {dest} leaving {station} on time?
platform.a: +{delay} min, expected at {expected} instead of {planned} — from platform {platform} as planned.
platform.note: Delays and platform changes come from the Deutsche Bahn timetable interface, for every part of the station — the deep-level and suburban platforms of Berlin's main station included.

region.title: Punctuality across a conurbation
region.q: Are buses and trains in the Rhine-Ruhr area running on time right now?
region.a: {share} % of the trips observed in the last hour were more than 5 minutes late — more than the hour before ({before} %).
region.note: The Rhine-Ruhr area answers as one region: 30 districts and cities together. ViaFrei gives totals per region, not per line.

tomorrow.title: Roadworks on tomorrow's route
tomorrow.q: Which roadworks are planned on the A7 tomorrow?
tomorrow.a: {count} roadworks sites, {started} of them already under way. One of them: between {a} and {b} a bridge is being rebuilt, over {km} km, speed limit {speed} km/h, until {until}.
tomorrow.note: Planned roadworks from the Federal Highway Research Institute: section and period, no coordinates and no live delay — what is happening right now, ViaFrei answers from the motorway reports.

closure.title: A closure ahead
closure.q: Is anything closed on the A7 near Hamburg right now?
closure.a: Yes: Autobahn GmbH reports a closed ramp at the {at} junction — on the roadworks section between {a} and {b}. This construction phase ends on {until} at {end}.
closure.note: Closures and roadworks on the motorways come from Autobahn GmbH, with the period of each construction phase.

weather.title: A weather check before the mountains
weather.q: Is there a weather warning for {name} today?
weather.a: Yes, for the coming night: the German Weather Service warns of light frost down to {temp} °C, valid on {day} from {from} to {to} — warning level {level}, the lowest.
weather.note: Warnings are read every 5 minutes and apply per area; a new one can be issued at short notice.

fuelcity.title: The cheapest E10 in town
fuelcity.q: Where is Super E10 cheapest in Cologne right now?
fuelcity.a: No new price yet — the lowest last known: €{euro}.{cent} per litre at {station}, {address}, reported on {reported}; ViaFrei is asking for a new one.
fuelcity.note: Fuel prices change every few minutes: this figure is an example from that afternoon, not today's price. ViaFrei says when the station reported every price it gives.

charger.a: At {site}: {points} charging points, Type 2, up to {kw}.{kwd} kW, €{euro}.{cent}/kWh before VAT. None reports occupied; for {stale} the last status dates from {t}, for {unknown} there is none — so not “free”.
charger.title: Live status at a charger
charger.q: Is a charging point free at {address} right now?
charger.note: We give live occupancy only where the operator publishes it – here through e-clearing.net. Without a report the answer is “no status data”, never “free”.

roadworks.a: In Lower Saxony {count}, all already begun; the first: {section}, from {start} to {end}.
roadworks.note: We cover federal roads in Lower Saxony, Saxony, Thuringia and Baden-Württemberg, from the data of their road authorities: section and period, no live delay. For a federal road elsewhere, ViaFrei answers “not covered” – not “clear”.
roadworks.title: Roadworks on a federal road
roadworks.q: Which roadworks are planned on the B3 in Lower Saxony this week?

train.title: Regional rail, on time or not
train.q: Is the next regional train from {station} to {dest} on time?
train.a: Yes: {line} at {planned} from platform {platform}, on time — like {n} of {all} regional trains up to {last}.
train.note: When the Deutsche Bahn timetable interface gives no live times, ViaFrei adds regional and S-Bahn trains from DELFI SIRI ET – in a block of their own, never mixed into the railway's lines.

fuelroad.a: No new price yet — the lowest last known: €{euro}.{cent} per litre at {station}, {address}, reported on {reported}; ViaFrei is asking for a new one.
fuelroad.title: Diesel on the way, by the motorway
fuelroad.q: I'm driving the A3 past Würzburg tonight: where is diesel cheapest nearby?
fuelroad.note: Fuel prices change every few minutes: this figure is an example from that afternoon, not today's price. ViaFrei says when the station reported every price it gives.

fuelland.a: No new price yet — the lowest last known: €{euro}.{cent} per litre at {station}, {address}, reported on {reported}; ViaFrei is asking for a new one.
fuelland.title: The cheapest price in a state capital
fuelland.q: Where is E10 cheapest in Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg, right now?

connectPage.notCoveredLead: So you don't look for what isn't there:

notCovered.routing: No door-to-door routing or journey planning — ViaFrei answers about places, roads and feeds, never “how do I get there”.
notCovered.cityStreets: No city-street traffic beyond the city and Land feeds we carry: street works, closures and traffic messages for Berlin, Cologne (closures for events), Hannover (once its feed publishes), Schleswig-Holstein including Kiel, and Baden-Württemberg including Stuttgart. Other cities are not covered; elsewhere the live traffic we hold is the federal motorway network (Autobahn GmbH) and, where a feed carries them, federal roads, plus roadworks on Land roads in Baden-Württemberg, Lower Saxony, Saxony and Thuringia.
notCovered.fares: No fares, tickets or booking of any kind.
notCovered.lineRealtime: No punctuality figure for one named line — “is the S1 on time?” is answered train by train at a railway station (the live delay of each departing train, S-Bahn included) and per region with the line’s service alerts; a bus, tram or U-Bahn stop gets the timetable only.
notCovered.forecast: No weather forecast — official DWD warnings only, and only while they are in force.
notCovered.parkingTariffs: No parking tariffs, and no promise that a space is free unless the operator publishes occupancy.

connectPage.privacy1: You need no account with us, and we keep no questions under your name.
connectPage.privacy2: Third-party measurement runs only if you agree; nothing is loaded from third parties before that. We count visits without cookies, as daily totals on our own server.

prompts.plan_departure: Briefs a drive about to start: weather warnings at both ends, open motorways and live jams, ending in a go/no-go sentence.
prompts.compare_travel_options: Weighs one trip by car against the same trip by rail: closures and jams on one side, departures and punctuality on the other.
prompts.prepare_car_trip: Collects what a driver must carry and know before driving in Germany and into one city: emission badge, speed limits, winter tyres, alcohol limit, tolls, mandatory equipment.
prompts.plan_fuel_stop: Finds where to fill up or charge on the way: the cheapest stations for one fuel grade, or chargers with the right connector and power, and the rest area beside them.
prompts.plan_commute: Plans one public-transport leg on the day: the next departures with delays, platforms and cancellations, and whether the region is running normally.
prompts.plan_arrival_parking: Finds where to leave the car at the end of the drive: a car park in town, park-and-ride at the edge with onward departures, or a rest area if early.
prompts.find_a_place: Resolves a bare name into a place, a named thing or an address, trying each in turn.
prompts.plan_local_errand: Answers “what is around here” for one place: the nearest fuel, charging, parking, station and motorway junction at a glance.
prompts.explain_this_coordinate: Turns a bare lat/lon into a sentence a traveller understands: the nearest address, settlement, district and motorway junction, each with its distance.

privacy.title: Your place stays with you.
privacy.body: ViaFrei creates no account and no profile and does not store your place. Your browser remembers a place on this device only when you choose it in the place bar – a place or an address, “Use my location” or “All of Germany” – together with your recent places; while this page uses a remembered place, a line under the place bar says so, and “Forget place” deletes it at once. The page asks for your location only when you choose “Use my location”; if you have already allowed it permanently in your browser, this page reads it without asking and stores nothing. Your location is rounded on your device to an area of about 500 m, and our server derives the street or place name for it from that area; it keeps that name in memory for at most an hour per area, without any link to you, and does not store it. Only right after that click, and only if your browser gives your location to within 150 m, the page sends the exact position once to our server to check whether you are at a station, a fuel station, a charging site or a motorway rest area; it is neither stored nor logged there. It keeps the name of a station, place or address chosen here in memory for at most an hour in the same way. Your IP address is used only in memory, for the approximate location, and is not stored for it. This applies on every page with the place bar, including the station index. On the station index, the place found this way is used only to show the nearest stations and stops.
